reason: This plugin is primarily an interface customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness web users, focused on theme and layout styling. Evidence shows it supplies built-in color presets, a settings panel for real-time appearance adjustments, and save/import/export/share of local theme schemes, with additional runtime controls via a global console API, and no broader automation, data, or external workflow behavior.

summaries.zh: StyleVault 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 的主题插件，提供大量预设配色并在界面设置中支持颜色、字体、字号和圆角等外观调整，同时可保存、导入、导出并分享方案。
summaries.en: StyleVault is a DeepSeek Harness theme plugin that offers multiple built-in style presets with in-app appearance controls for colors, fonts, sizing, and corner radius, plus saving, importing, exporting, and sharing of style schemes.

capabilities: Live adjustment of style tokens (color, typography, radius)
Import/export and sharing of theme scheme JSON
Console API for runtime theme operations and scheme management
Persistence of selected scheme and default restore behavior
Optional remote font loading via web font sources

reasons.code: README describes a DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with 30+ presets, a Settings → StyleVault panel, and live-editable color, font, scale, and radius controls.
README documents scheme and token controls through __STYLEVAULT__ methods such as set, override, setFonts, setOptions, export, import, saveScheme, schemes, and useOfficial.
Package metadata declares DSH web client injection modules for UI theme/slots/settings runtime and exposes bundle patching, consistent with appearance customization within the client UI.
Repository description and README topics identify the plugin as a theme/style plugin for DeepSeek Harness ("classic themes + Style Settings").
